text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. Break large tasks into smaller steps and set your own mini-deadlines. Prioritization is also key: decide which tasks are most urgent and focus on them first. Sometimes you may need scope management, which means reducing what you plan to do so the most important parts are finished on time. Finally, communication matters. If you realise you cannot meet a deadline, tell your manager or team early. They may help you or adjust the plan. With these habits, deadlines feel less stressful.
